cent: noun. A subunit of currency equal to one-hundredth of the main unit of currency in many countries.

come: verb. To move nearer to the point of perspective.

cop: verb. To capture or arrest someone.

met: verb. simple past and past participle of meet

monte: noun. A game in which three or four cards are dealt face - up and players bet on which of them will first be matched in suit by others dealt.
mop: noun. An implement for washing floors or similar, made of a piece of cloth, or a collection of thrums, or coarse yarn, fastened to a handle.
mope: verb. To carry oneself in a depressed, lackadaisical manner; to give oneself up to low spirits; to pout, sulk.
